purpose: Retain strong matching timing rulesets as reusable frozen candidates without upgrading post-outcome development matches into validation.
owner_instruction: Whenever a very good matching ruleset is found, save it into the current merged candidate ruleset.
operating_rules: Store the exact executable rule or an exact source artifact reference, not only an interpretation.
Record whether the motivating outcome was known before the rule was created.
Retain misses, false positives, ties, and transfer failures next to successes.
Do not silently retune an existing candidate after a transfer miss; create a separately versioned candidate.
Endpoint-specific rules are routed only to their declared endpoint and are not blended into generic timing by default.
A development candidate remains unvalidated until it succeeds under an untouched prospective or cross-person protocol.
